name: Alps Kitchen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Alps Kitchen in Fiss – your culinary escape in the heart of Tirol!**

Indulge in authentic Tyrolean flavors and hearty mountain dishes in a cozy, rustic setting. Our menu features **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, and fresh trout from the Inn River—all crafted with local ingredients.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, Fiss offers breathtaking Alpine views and charming villages. Whether you're craving a warm **Käsespätzle** or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel**, our kitchen is your gateway to true Tyrolean hospitality.

**Come taste the Alps!** 🏔️🍽️

---
*Opening hours: Daily 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM*
